reason: The cornea and lens both bend light, so they look like the starting pieces for the focusing front.
expectation: They will form part of the eye's focusing front.

alternatives.reason: The lining is a separate goal, and these cells seem likely to connect.

effect: The cornea and lens now form a focusing front; the iris still appears needed to control light.
reaction: The picture makes it clear how both pieces bend light toward the back.
reason: The iris has an opening that can narrow, so it should add light control to the focusing front.
expectation: The iris will join the front and control how much light passes through.

alternatives.reason: I could work on the separate light-sensitive lining first.

effect: The eye front is complete; the remaining goal is to build the light-sensitive lining and its nerve.
reaction: The picture clarified where the iris sits between the cornea and lens.
reason: The light-sensitive cells and nerve cells are the remaining pieces for the lining and outgoing nerve.
expectation: They will form a light-sensitive lining connected to nerve fibres.

effect: The light-sensitive cells and nerve cells formed the retina and optic nerve; the next goal is to join the lining to the eye front.
reaction: The picture helped me see how the fibres gather into an outgoing bundle.
reason: The new goal explicitly asks to bring the focusing front and sensing lining together.
expectation: They will form an eye cutaway that focuses light onto the retina.

effect: The completed eye brings the focusing front and retina together, showing light focused on the retina and signals traveling toward the brain.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the separate parts work together in one picture.

mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the two halves was most worthwhile because the finished cutaway connected focusing light with sending information toward the brain.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the iris was clear but fairly predictable once its narrowing opening was shown.

surprise.text: I learned that the light-sensitive lining is called the retina and that nerve fibres gather into the optic nerve.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: building the eye from separate pieces made me curious about how another sense works.
